paper_title: First Results from Axion Haloscope at CAPP around 10.7 $μ$eV
notes: Paper reports two exclusion regions at 90% CL: (1) 10.7126–10.7186 µeV with near-KSVZ coupling sensitivity (g_agamma ≈ 3.6×10^-16 GeV^-1 for KSVZ model with g_γ=0.97); (2) 10.16–11.37 µeV with ~9× larger coupling (g_agamma ≈ 3.2×10^-15 GeV^-1). KSVZ coupling extracted from Eq. (1) and standard axion-photon coupling formula g_agamma = g_γ × α_em / (π f_a), using g_γ=0.97 (KSVZ) and f_a derived from m_a via Λ≈f_a²m_a≈78 MeV. Local DM density ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³ explicitly stated in Eq. (1). This is the first axion haloscope result in these mass ranges and the coldest cavity experiment to date (T_cav = 38 mK). Data points represent the boundaries of the two excluded regions. | selector: text (sole candidate)
